headline: Walmart Tops Q3 Earnings Expectations and Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Walmart reported stronger-than-expected third-quarter sales and profits as cost-conscious shoppers boosted store traffic. The company raised its full-year financial outlook for the third time this year.
why: Walmart is the world's largest retailer by revenue and a key barometer of U.S. consumer spending and retail health.

impacts.name: Walmart
impacts.why: Walmart beat quarterly expectations and raised its full-year sales and profit outlook.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Strong third-quarter sales growth across income demographics prompted Walmart to lift its annual guidance.
